<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php'; require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php'; require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/media.php';
$photo = function ( $file, $title ) { $tmp = wp_tempnam( $file ); copy( get_theme_file_path( 'assets/images/' . $file ), $tmp ); $id = media_handle_sideload( array( 'name' => $file, 'tmp_name' => $tmp ), 0 ); if ( is_wp_error( $id ) ) { return 0; } wp_update_post( array( 'ID' => $id, 'post_title' => $title ) ); return $id; };
$product = function ( $name ) { $p = get_posts( array( 'post_type' => 'product', 'title' => $name, 'numberposts' => 1, 'fields' => 'ids' ) ); return $p ? (int) $p[0] : 0; };
update_option( 'cinnamon_novedades', array(
  array( 'image' => $photo( 'portada-frutos-secos.jpg', 'Novedad: frutos secos' ), 'title' => 'Frutos Secos', 'text' => 'Descuentos desde 500 g y mejor precio por kilo', 'url' => home_url( '/categoria/frutos-secos/' ), 'product' => 0, 'active' => true ),
  array( 'image' => $photo( 'portada-condimentos.jpg', 'Novedad: cúrcuma en polvo' ), 'title' => 'Cúrcuma en polvo', 'text' => '20 % de descuento en 500 g', 'url' => '', 'product' => $product( 'Cúrcuma en polvo' ), 'active' => true ),
  array( 'image' => $photo( 'portada-harinas.jpg', 'Novedad: harina de almendras' ), 'title' => 'Harina de almendras', 'text' => '20 % de descuento en 1 kg', 'url' => '', 'product' => $product( 'Harina de almendras' ), 'active' => true ),
  array( 'image' => $photo( 'portada-semillas.jpg', 'Novedad: semillas de chía' ), 'title' => 'Semillas de chía', 'text' => '15 % de descuento en 1 kg', 'url' => '', 'product' => $product( 'Semillas de chía' ), 'active' => true ),
), false );
$until = ( new DateTimeImmutable( 'now', wp_timezone() ) )->modify( '+3 days' )->format( 'Y-m-d\TH:i' );
update_option( 'cinnamon_avisos', array( array( 'text' => 'Aviso de ejemplo: ==Cyber Monday==, hasta **30% extra** en productos', 'url' => home_url( '/ofertas/' ), 'from' => '', 'until' => $until, 'style' => 'black', 'font' => 'figtree', 'size' => 'normal', 'motion' => 'ninguno', 'countdown' => true ) ), false );
$plans = cinnamon_sub_plans();
foreach ( $plans as $i => &$row ) { foreach ( array( 'mvd', 'int' ) as $zone ) { $row[ $zone . '_url' ] = 'https://www.mercadopago.com.uy/subscriptions/checkout?preapproval_plan_id=ejemplo-cafe-' . $i . '-' . $zone; } }
unset( $row );
update_option( 'cinnamon_suscripcion_planes', $plans, false );
$flour = wc_get_product( $product( 'Harina de almendras' ) );
if ( $flour ) {
  foreach ( cinnamon_psub_presentations( $flour ) as $id => $label ) {
    if ( '1 kg' !== $label ) { continue; }
    $links = array();
    foreach ( array_keys( cinnamon_psub_amounts( wc_get_product( $id ), 900 ) ) as $amount ) { $links[ $amount ] = 'https://www.mercadopago.com.uy/subscriptions/checkout?preapproval_plan_id=ejemplo-harina-' . $amount; }
    update_post_meta( $flour->get_id(), '_cin_sub_enabled', 'yes' );
    update_post_meta( $flour->get_id(), '_cin_sub_items', array( $id => array( 'price' => 900, 'links' => $links ) ) );
  }
}
